title: Semiconductor Industry Sets Out Research Needed to Advance Emerging Technologies, Unleash Next-Generation Semiconductors
主要内容: A coalition of global tech, defense, and aerospace leaders, led by the Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA) and Semiconductor Research Corporation (SRC), released a report titled 'Semiconductor Research Opportunities: An Industry Vision and Guide.' The report highlights the need for government and industry investment in research to advance semiconductor technology beyond silicon-based systems and next-generation manufacturing methods. John Neuffer, SIA's CEO, stressed the importance of semiconductors to U.S. innovation and global leadership, while expressing concern over proposed cuts to basic research in the Trump administration's 2018 budget. Ken Hansen, SRC's CEO, noted that semiconductor advancements have driven growth in industries like automotive, and collaboration between industry, government, and academia is essential as scaling slows. The Vision report, developed over nine months in 2016-2017, outlines 14 research areas, including advanced packaging, communications, and security, to guide future innovation and competitiveness.
